title: Print Uniform Block Spacing
description: Fix inconsistent vertical spacing between chapters, sections, paragraphs, windows, and other block elements in print LaTeX. All inter-block gaps must use exactly one spacing unit (semio@spacing@single).
summary: Fixed inconsistent gap above heading chips when body text precedes them. Root cause: pre-chip vspace inside titleformat [block] never entered the page vertical list. Moved pre-chip gap to titlesec titlespacing before-sep (2× single unit) and unified SemioNest/window block@before to the same skip register. Chip-to-body gap stays at 1× single via titlespacing after / block@after. Removed block@sep@done flag and row@wrap internal vskip.
